operations.title: The gravitational readout tower has one normalization torsor, fixed numerically only by an independent scale-bearing datum
operations.statement: After freezing action, asymptotic-field, external-state, charge, and detector conventions, all established soft-Ward-memory rungs should be compatible with one scalar kappa satisfying kappa^2=32 pi G. Structural comparison can determine invariant ratios and the dimension of the normalization freedom, but cannot select a numerical dimensionful G without an independently derived integral, period, or scale-bearing normalization.

operations.title: Cross-rung single-kappa coherence and normalization-torsor audit
operations.protocol: Extract every established leading, subleading, and bounded S2 comparison coefficient in one frozen convention packet. Compute the allowed rescaling action, its quotient invariants, and the residual parameter space. Pass: all squares commute with one kappa and the residual freedom is one-dimensional. Fail: incompatible kappas or more than one independent normalization remains. Numerical-G claim is admissible only if a source-derived scale-bearing datum canonically points the residual torsor.

authority_basis.instruction: Push a few moves toward recovery of the closest fundamental constant while the background computation runs.
